demos.title: Boids
demos.summary: 300-agent flocking sim with alignment, cohesion and separation you can reweight live.
demos.prompt: Boids flocking simulation on canvas: alignment/cohesion/separation weights as sliders, pointer attraction, click to scatter, wraparound edges.
demos.notes: O(n²) neighbour scan is fine at 300 agents. Motion trails use a translucent overlay clear.

demos.title: Command Palette
demos.summary: Fuzzy command palette with keyboard nav inside a fake mail app. Cmd/Ctrl+K to open.
demos.prompt: Command palette component demo: Cmd/Ctrl+K opens an overlay, fuzzy subsequence matching with highlighted hits, grouped results, arrow-key navigation, Enter to run, Esc to close.
demos.notes: Matching is a greedy subsequence scan with a streak bonus, not an edit-distance ranker.

demos.title: Flow Field
demos.summary: 2,600 particles riding a seeded noise field. Pointer bends the current, click reseeds.
demos.prompt: Canvas flow-field particle system: seeded value noise, additive trails, pointer disturbance, reseed on click, density and speed sliders.
demos.notes: Particles are pooled; density slider adds/removes entries instead of reallocating. Trails come from a low-alpha fill, not per-particle history.

demos.title: Sorting Race
demos.summary: Bubble vs insertion vs merge vs quick, stepped as generators so every comparison is visible.
demos.prompt: Sorting visualizer racing four algorithms side by side. Each algorithm is a generator yielding after every compare/write so one frame can advance N ops; show comparison and write counters plus finish order.
demos.notes: Generators keep the algorithm bodies readable and make the race fair: every panel gets the same ops-per-frame budget. Same shuffled input for all four.
